learning_outcomes.text: explain the operating principles of piston and turbomachines
explain the design of piston and turbomachines of various types
explain and demonstrate the operating behavior of piston and turbomachines
calculate the main delivery data based on given values
select a suitable positive displacement or turbomachine for a given pumping task

syllabus_topics: Piston machines: operating principle, energy conversion, operation, types
Turbomachines: operating principle, energy conversion, operation, applications

assessment_methods.method: Exam (90 min) or other examination form

assessment_rules: The examination form will be announced at the beginning of the course. A passed module exam is required for the awarding of credit points. The grade is weighted according to credit points.
